title: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention

statement.en: You can dim or tint passthrough to draw attention to your content.
statement.ja: コンテンツへ注意を向けるために、パススルーを暗くしたり色を付けたりできる。

conditions: In the Shared Space, subtle dimming or tinting can draw attention without hiding other apps; in a Full Space it can create a more focused experience.
Passthrough is tinted black by default; a custom tint is optional.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Immersive experiences experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Use mixed immersion for unbounded 3D experiences

title: Use progressive immersion to blend an environment with surroundings

conditions: Not every task benefits from immersion, and an immersive task need not be fully immersive.
Design focused opportunities for immersion rather than assuming the experience should be fully immersive most of the time.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Immersive experiences experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるImmersive experiencesの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Avoid obscuring passthrough in mixed immersion

statement.en: When using mixed immersion, avoid obscuring too much passthrough.
statement.ja: mixed方式では、パススルーによる周囲の見え方を過度に遮らないようにする。

conditions: Preserve physical context that helps people understand and navigate their surroundings.
If virtual objects could substantially obscure passthrough, use progressive or full immersion instead of mixed immersion.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Immersive experiences experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Indicate an immersive exit control’s purpose

statement.en: Indicate the purpose of an immersive-experience exit control.
statement.ja: 没入体験から出る操作が何を行うのかを示す。

conditions: Differentiate returning to a previous, less immersive context from quitting the experience.
If exiting also quits the app or game, consider controls that let people pause or return somewhere they can save progress before quitting.
